definition.name: The Knotkeeper
definition.signature: Starts with two Clinging Thoughts in the enemy half of the grid, locking nearby Recall. A Shuttle moves stacks while Memory Holes threaten their landing places. Opening thoughts wait until after your first turn to attack.
definition.counter: Kill the Binder or Shuttle before the committed disruption.
